title: Coral Pink Ikat Print Cotton Tunic Top for Women – Short Kurti for Jeans
color_custom: Coral pink with white ikat print
description:
Gulabo means rosy – a cheerful coral pink scattered with soft white ikat drops.

A bright coral pink cotton tunic printed all over in an ikat-style pattern – soft-edged white and pale pink drops that look hand-woven. A mandarin collar with a front slit and a short wooden-look button placket keep it smart, and the curved hem sits neatly over jeans.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin collar with a front V-slit
• Short button placket with three buttons
• 3/4 sleeves
• Straight cut with a curved hem, hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, light and breathable, made for all-day comfort.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans, clear heels and oxidised silver jhumkas, as in our photos; white trousers for office; a ponytail and sneakers for college or a day out.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
